args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` should round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

transcript.reasoning_content: Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Note Decimal("2.675") with quantize HALF_EVEN gives 2.68 (since 2.675 in decimal is exact, half-even: 2.675 -> digit before is 7, odd -> round up to 8). Yes correct.
